race.comment: RALOS STAR (13) is knocking on the door, beaten half a length at Gatton last week after a narrow BM58 fourth on the turf here, and his one crack on the Poly produced a win. Can get the job done this time. UNFAITHFUL (4) returns and will be looking to kick-off this prep in identical fashion to last campaign where she put two on the bounce. The form around her last time in reads strongly and two trials should have her forward enough. McColm's 3kg claim sets her up well and she can return with a bang. SLING (9) is another winning hope. He beat home UNFAITHFUL in a recent trial and has figures that measure right up for a race of this calibre. Thompson's booking is a big push. IT'S KAOS (8) has to rebound from a flat run at the Gold Coast. Suspect her maiden win on the turf is a better indicator.
